runtime.derivation: Resize each source atlas to an exact 1024 square grid, crop selected 256 cells, downsample to 128, mirror on both axes into seamless 256 materials, strip metadata, and PNG-compress.
runtime.sampling: Eight-by-eight continuous map-space source regions prevent the material motif from restarting on every tile.

blocker_tree_palette.derivation: Normalize the original transparent 4x4 generation to an exact grid, crop each source cell, contain into 128x128 without distortion, preserve alpha, clear transparent fringe pixels, and assemble one runtime atlas.
